findings.evidence: PR line 211 declares `lemma orbitRel_mapOfLE_mk`; its statement at line 212 applies `Setoid.map_of_le`. Mathlib defines `def map_of_le` in `Mathlib/Data/Setoid/Basic.lean:230`, and the existing Mathlib theorem over the same API is `continuous_map_of_le` in `Mathlib/Topology/Constructions.lean:192`.
findings.fix: Rename this lemma to `orbitRel_map_of_le_mk` and update the single local rewrite use accordingly.
findings.issue: `orbitRel_mapOfLE_mk` names a theorem about `Setoid.map_of_le` using `mapOfLE`, but the Mathlib source declaration is snake_case `Setoid.map_of_le`; the naming guide says `_`-separated theorem-name components should correspond to definition names when referring to namespaced definitions outside their namespace.

summary: One introduced public lemma uses nonstandard terminology for the declaration it is naming; the rest of the introduced names and notation are acceptable from this angle.
